conditions: A handled exception raised in the executable part of a nested PL/SQL block, with normal completion of the matching handler.
limitations: The caller or host takes control when there is no enclosing block. Separate passages govern exceptions raised during a declaration or within a handler.

triggers: Publisher revision, archived-byte drift, a documented qualifier, contrary source evidence or a controller change.

statement: In the Oracle 19c reference, an exception raised in a block’s executable part stops that part. When the block’s matching handler completes normally, execution continues after the inner block in its enclosing block, where one exists.
